annotations.title: Publish a clip to social media

description: Publish a finished clip to one of the user's connected social accounts (YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, Instagram, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads), now or at schedule_at (future, at most 7 days ahead). Call katto_list_connected_accounts first to see which platforms are connected (and not in need of a reconnect); katto_generate_post_text can draft the caption. This posts PUBLICLY on the user's behalf and cannot be undone from Katto: before calling, show the user the clip, the platform, the caption (and TikTok privacy level) and get their explicit confirmation; never publish on your own initiative or retry a publish blindly (each call is a new post). Requires a paid plan; scheduling requires Creator. If the platform is not connected you get an error with code platform_not_connected and a connect_url: ask the user to connect it in the Katto dashboard, then retry. TikTok requires privacy_level chosen by the user (no default) and disclosure of commercial content (brand_content / brand_organic); until Katto's TikTok app is audited, TikTok only accepts posts to a private account. Returns { status: 'published', result } or { status: 'scheduled', scheduled_post_id, scheduled_at }.

brand_content.description: TikTok only: the post is a paid partnership (labelled 'Paid partnership'; cannot be SELF_ONLY).

brand_organic.description: TikTok only: the post promotes the user's own business (labelled 'Promotional content').

caption.description: Post text. On YouTube it is used as the title and description unless title/description are given.

description.description: YouTube description. Defaults to the caption.

platform.description: Where to post. The account must already be connected in the Katto dashboard.

privacy_level.description: TikTok only, REQUIRED for TikTok: who can see the post. Must be chosen by the user, never assumed.

schedule_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 date-time to publish later instead of now (future, at most 7 days ahead). Scheduling is a Creator feature.

title.description: YouTube video title (max 100 characters). Defaults to the caption, then the clip's title.

name: katto_publish_clip
